# Tandon Associates

> India's AI-powered legal research, case management, document drafting, and eCourts tracking platform for lawyers, law firms, corporate legal teams, and law students.

Tandon Associates combines grounded Indian legal AI (IPC, CrPC, CPC, Constitution, landmark judgments) with practice-management tools — cases, clients, calendar, contracts, conflict checks, billing, and an immutable audit trail. A free Student Hub provides a Moot Court Simulator, Case Brief Generator (IRAC), and Statute Simplifier.
